description: DEF CON 33 Blacks in Cybersecurity Village features talks, panels, and workshops highlighting career advancement, diversity, and technical tradecraft. Sessions cover reverse engineering with Ghidra, cyberbiosecurity, AI-driven phishing analysis, DNS threat intelligence, and community initiatives across the global cyber ecosystem.

talks.title: RE for the Rest of Us: An Introduction to Reverse Engineering
talks.teaser: Introduces reverse engineering fundamentals using hands-on Arduino hardware and Ghidra binary analysis demos.

talks.title: From Wake Island to the War Room
talks.teaser: Nykolas Muldrow shares experiences navigating cybersecurity leadership and operations from remote military outposts to national defense missions.

talks.title: The Truth, Whole Truth and Nothing But the Truth of Cybersecurity
talks.teaser: Provides an unfiltered critique of cybersecurity industry hype, vendor promises, and the necessity of practical foundational security over shiny tools.

talks.title: Cyber Game Changers: Women Who Lead, Secure and Inspire
talks.teaser: A panel of women leaders in cybersecurity share real-world career journeys, technical insights, and strategies for advancing industry diversity.

talks.title: Petty Proteins: When Molecules Go Rogue and Why Cyberbiosecurity Matters
talks.teaser: Explores how AI-designed proteins and biological vulnerabilities mirror cybersecurity attack vectors, highlighting the emerging field of cyberbiosecurity.

talks.title: The African Cybercrime Economy
talks.teaser: Examines the mechanics of the African cybercrime economy and highlights initiatives like GoLegit Africa that create technical training pathways away from cybercrime.

talks.title: Following Threat Actors' Rhythm to Give Them More Blues
talks.teaser: Introduces Domain Intelligence Analysis, leveraging proactive DNS artifacts and registration telemetry to detect adversary infrastructure before public IOC disclosures.

talks.title: How AI Is Revolutionizing Phishing Attacks & Defenses
talks.teaser: Explores the dual role of artificial intelligence in scaling hyper-targeted phishing campaigns while powering real-time behavioral defenses.
talks.summary:
The AI Arms Race in Phishing Attacks

Artificial intelligence and large language models enable cyber adversaries to automate highly tailored, grammatically flawless spear-phishing campaigns at planetary scale, defeating traditional email reputation filters.

AI-Powered Defensive Filtering and Behavioral Analysis

To counter automated threats, defenders deploy machine learning models that analyze communication context, sender behavioral anomalies, and linguistic stylometry in real time.

Evaluating the Dual-Edged AI Security Landscape

Levone Campbell compares offensive generation techniques against adaptive defensive filtering, providing organizations with actionable strategies to secure human communication channels.

talks.title: Embedded System Design vs Traditional Software Design
talks.teaser: Compares embedded systems architecture with traditional software development, focusing on bare-metal programming, bus protocols, and hardware debugging.

talks.title: Breaking Down Bias in the Cyber Stack
talks.teaser: Identifies subtle systemic biases across technical security controls, organizational policies, and hiring pipelines, offering actionable remediation strategies.

talks.title: Price of Progress: Ethical Cybersecurity in Tech Communities
talks.teaser: Examines ethical challenges and community responsibilities surrounding technological progress and cybersecurity practices in tech communities.

talks.title: How Basketball Officiating Shaped a Cybersecurity Career
talks.teaser: Connects real-time decision-making, conflict resolution, and rule enforcement from basketball officiating to incident response and SOC operations.

talks.title: BIC Pick: DEF CON 33 Badge Walkthrough
talks.teaser: Eli McRae provides a technical walkthrough of the DEF CON 33 Blacks in Cybersecurity Village electronic badge, covering PCB schematics and SAO support.

talks.title: Let's Lose the Shock: Mystery of Linux - A Pain Free Intro
talks.teaser: Demystifies the Linux operating system for beginners through relatable Windows comparisons, core architecture explanations, and command-line tips.
